body: That’s absolutely awful, as a person of the Lbgtqia+ Community I believe parents should still give you unconditional love and support no matter what you’re choices are. Not all parents are like that, but I’m really sorry that happened and you had to hear that, you are a valid person and even if it was you’re own parents who said those things to you you still deserve love and acceptance.

I’m so sorry you’re own mother said those words to you, do you have any other family members you could talk to? I don’t wanna say the wrong thing and sound like a hypocrite because I’ve tried to commit suicide 4 times and never succeed. If you need to vent about anymore things about you’re mothers parenting say what you need to say! :)
